Items wave 1 (session-engine, tasks-screen; merged into the branch at f36511e) left for later areas, plus problems the wave-1 reviewers and merge agent saw. Full wave-1 report: /tmp/frbench/wave1.json (areas[].fix/review/fixup: fixed, not_done, new_problems, notes_for_other_areas, review non_blocking; merge.problems_left). session-engine and tasks-screen are finished, so the files they owned (runner.ts, compose.ts, server.ts sessions/commands sections, api-types.ts, task.ts commands, client.ts, fake-daemon.ts, real-daemon.test.ts) are open to the area an item is assigned to here: make the smallest change that does the item, keep their tests green. Each item is yours to fix, or to report in not_done with a reason.

Wave 2 (needs-me, chat; merged and pushed at 3455a24) added the items marked 'wave 2' below. Full wave-2 report: /tmp/frbench/wave2.json (areas[].fix/review/fixup and merge.problems_left; notes_for_other_areas there describe the new APIs: HumanRequestView title/body/choices/outcome from packages/runtime/src/daemon/request-words.ts, InboxView.needsYouCount, session/resume-work.ts resumeWork(), task-words.ts holdsTask(card), @forerunner/critic triedTimes(), conversation/card-fate.ts cardFate(), daemon/start-blocked.ts startBlocked(), the shared Conversation.tsx used by the Chat tab and Talk, GET /projects/:id/conversation). needs-me and chat are finished too, so their files (request-words.ts, InboxPage, intake.ts, conversation/*, commands executor) may be edited for an item below, with a test, keeping their behaviour.

Phase C (plan in docs/status/handoff/NEXT-SESSION.md) items are under 'phase-C'; phase E (sweep) items under 'later'. Live reports: /tmp/frbench/live1-report.md, /tmp/frbench/live2-report.md (part 3 is on current code).
needs-me: Echoes: every person's command sentence is still posted as an Inbox message by packages/commands/src/executor.ts ('Stopped "X": its run ended…', 'Added "X" to P.', 'Switched the active project to Quote page. Undo.', the chat's 'Stopped your agent's running sessions (1 run, 0 processes).'). Design §5.11: Updates never echo the person's own clicks or commands. Stop posting them to the Inbox (the Changes page and the chat reply still show them); coordinate with chat (same wave) by owning executor.ts's Inbox posting yourself.

The critic's retry card (kind 'approval', change_card reason 'retry_ladder_exhausted', packages/runtime/src/loop/critic.ts ~418) makes its task read 'Needs your answer' and offers 'Go ahead without' (explained as 'the specialist decides'), which queues a 'without answering the questions' note. Redesign it per design (Try again / Mark done anyway / Cancel task), give TaskDisplay.blocker the card kind so the Tasks tab offers Try again for it, and word its text without 'Retry ladder exhausted … attempt(s)'. The card for a task made ready and done must close (reviewer saw 'Retry ladder exhausted' for Quote page stay open after the task was done).
'Mark done anyway' (Inbox card only, ADR 0102 decision 2) writes a reason containing 'accepted without review' so the task display reads 'Done: accepted without review'.
A person task ('Me: ask me in the Inbox', specialist 'person') must offer only Answer and Cancel, never 'Go ahead without' (no specialist exists).

Withdrawn cards: a person's task move withdraws its open cards (status withdrawn). An Inbox Answered/history list can show them as 'withdrawn: you moved the task', and after Undo the card comes back open (HumanRequestRepo.reopenWithdrawn).

POST /changes/:id/undo (server.ts) emits no 'inbox' event after an undo, so the header's Inbox count stays stale after an Undo on the Changes page. Add rt.events.emit('inbox', {}) after rt.commands.undo, with a test.

Failed-task card: after a failed task's retries the runner leaves it needs_human (critic sign-off card) or failed; the result's first line names it. File the failed-task card from runner.ts after the failed transition (the synthesis allows needs-me to add only this call there).

'The person chose to go ahead without answering': tasks-screen queues WITHOUT_ANSWERS_NOTE on Go ahead without; make sure it reaches the task's next brief next to answersBlockFor (executor.ts / session/task-context.ts) and test it on the brief.

Before the plan is approved, the Start dialog's unblock button is 'Open Tasks', but the real unblocker is the plan card in the Inbox. Make start-check's blocked reason intake-aware (kind e.g. 'plan_waiting', action a link to the plan card: 'Review the plan'), with a real-daemon case and the fake daemon change.
Approving the plan gives no confirmation (smoke finding): after Approve, say what happens next ('Approved. Start runs the 5 tasks.' / Approve and start) per design.

Spec O.9 'You said during the session:' report is appended under the session's one-line Update and quotes the person's words back; remove that echo (or move it where the design puts it) consistently with §5.11.
chat: Wire CommandPorts.stopTask in packages/runtime/src/daemon/compose.ts (CommandLoop ports: stopTask: (id, r) => kill.stopTask(id, r, { by: 'you' })) so a chat or voice 'pause'/'cancel' of a RUNNING task stops its run at once. Test it at the chat boundary.

Typing 'stop' in Chat freezes the agent (session.stop with the agent scope: Stop all, the stopped bar until 'Allow sessions again'). Design §3.9: chat 'stop' / 'stop after this task' means the running session: send a session-scoped stop (Stop now) or POST /sessions/:id/pause (Stop after this task); only an explicit 'stop everything' / kill switch freezes. Whose-stop classification follows (one session is 'you').

The chat's command replies are also posted to the Inbox (executor.ts). needs-me owns removing that Inbox echo; your reply in the chat itself must read plainly (no '(1 run, 0 processes)', no 'Undo.' suffix).

New registry commands from tasks-screen: task.pause, task.resume {without_answers}, task.reopen, task.update, task.dependencies, and task.create (ready by default, depends_on, budget, specialist). Make sure the chat model gets them as tools and that the intent synonyms reach them ('pause the CSS task', 'make it wait for X', 'reopen …').
A 'task' item added to the Next session queue (the queue route / queue.add command) should become a ready task when queued, not stay a note.

Chat's context: read summary_cache.last_session.outcome (LastSessionOutcome, packages/runtime/src/session/result.ts) and next_steps (task titles) rather than parsing last_session.summary; tasks come with display labels (TaskView.display).

POST /projects with a name that already exists answers 500 {code: internal, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: project.name'}. If chat or the new-project flow can hit it, return a sentence ('There is already a project called X.') with a stable ForerunnerError code; test it at the route and in the UI.
progress-navigation: Running chip in the header ('Alice is working on "X"') and the Overview's 'Working now' after Start: use SessionView.statusText/stopReason/currentTask, the live 'session.changed' frames and 'project.changed {id}' events from /events.

BUG: the /events SSE 'session.changed' frame carries {type, payload} (server.ts onSession) but apps/ui/src/api/sse.ts parseDaemonEvent parses it as a SessionView and drops it, so in SSE mode the UI never receives session.changed (only polling does). Fix the parse with a test that feeds the real frame shape.

The session page: statusText reads 'Done' for sessions that ended with a task needing the person or a failed task; read last_session.outcome / the session's result so the badge says e.g. 'Ended: 1 task needs you'. An ended session keeps a faded disabled 'Stop now' button: remove it. The session page title is still a UUID: use the project and when it ran.

The project header still reads 'planning'/'good'/'active'/'blocked' badges during and after work; ProjectPage keeps its own fetch and goes stale. Use summary_cache.stage (build/done) and the design §2 project status sentence; follow project.changed events.

The Start dialog (StartSessionDialog.tsx + GET /projects/:id/start-check, from session-engine): dependency blockers worded from raw statuses ('(ready)', '(draft)') -> use TaskView.display labels; without a key it shows 'This session runs "X" (about CHF 1.20).' above 'Claude is not connected…' with Start disabled (contradiction: show only the blocker); after Start it shows both 'Started: … Open the session' and 'Starts after the current session; …' (re-reads busy start-check); the line 'needs about CHF 1.20, more than this session's work budget of CHF 4.00' is wrong/odd; 'continues with up to N more as they become ready' when those tasks are already ready. Start session leaves the Tasks tab for /sessions/:id in one place: per design §3.6 the person stays where they were with 'Open the session'.
Home's Continue and the Overview's Start/Continue: reuse start-check 'blocked' {kind, sentence, action} for the one-sentence stuck reason with the button that unblocks it.
Task drawer runs: show the live step lines (task.step events: read/wrote/ran) and make changed files openable (your Files view / Open folder).
The Reviews tab ignores ?review=: the drawer's 'The whole review' link lands on the unfiltered list. Honour it.

Task filters in the address do not survive switching project tabs, although docs/user-guide.md:100 and apps/ui/test/tasks.test.tsx:502's name claim they do: make the tab links keep the query (and keep the claim true).

The user guide's 'Stopping and crashes' paragraph says '**Stop** on a session's page stops it now'; the page has 'Stop after this task' (default) and 'Stop now'. Fix the guide (you own its structure).
apps/ui/src/mobile/screens/ReviewsScreen.tsx:166 still uses target=_blank (Android webview): use the same ExternalLink route as desktop or verify and document why it is safe.

A start that waits behind a running session (Start dialog: 'Starts after the current session') only begins on the scheduler's next tick, up to 30 s after the session before it ends (packages/runtime/src/session/triggers.ts: the drain is in tick(); requestStart's .finally only frees the agent). U-043's line says it 'runs when the session before it ends'. Drain the agent's waiting line when its active start ends (keep quiet-hours deferral and order), with a composed-runtime test and the Start dialog/session page showing it start. Also: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'Start while a session runs' now cancels its waiting starts itself (commit 5b1fb2b, a Windows CI timing failure); keep that cleanup.

wave 2: The header shows a red 'Stop all' while nothing runs. Design §3.1: Stop all appears only while something runs (and asks once). Every after-screenshot shows it, e.g. /tmp/frbench/fix-chat/steps/23-after-g-talk-panel.png.

wave 2: Home and project headers still show stage, health, autonomy and critic-grade badges ('planning', 'blocked', 'autonomy: Standard (level 2)') beside 'needs you: X'. Design §2: one status sentence replaces them. Health read 'attention' while the only open card was the Docker card, then 'blocked'. Use ProjectCard.needsYou (names the task of the oldest open card) and task-words.ts holdsTask(card) so the Docker card does not count as a decision.

wave 2: The header's project switcher keeps showing the last selected project ('Packing list') while another project's page ('Change me') is open (/tmp/frbench/fixup-needs-me/steps/51-c5-lost-draft-banner.png). Talk now follows the project on screen; on Home, commands typed in Talk act on the hidden 'active project'. Retire or align the header's active project.
wave 2: Shell.tsx's badge aria-label says 'N blocking' while the badge now counts every open card (needsYouCount). Words: 'N need you'.

wave 2: The stopped bar says 'Kill switch active: no session runs until you press Resume.' and the button reads 'Resume', while the chat says 'Allow sessions again'. One wording in header, chat and user guide (design §3.1). Conversation.tsx re-reads GET /health after a chat stop/resume, so store.killActive follows chat stops.
wave 2: 'Set up Docker' on the Docker card and the Start dialog's Settings link open /settings#sandbox but the page stays at the top; scroll to the hash (SettingsPage/Shell, in-app navigation).

wave 2: Start dialog while the plan waits still shows the old StartSessionDialog lines (StartSessionDialog.tsx:303-312: 'Give your agent work first: add a task…' and 'The plan from your brief waits for your approval in the Inbox…') under the new startBlocked sentence: three statements of one blocker, one pointing to the wrong place. Show only the startBlocked sentence with its one link.

wave 2: The Next-session queue's 'task' item (POST /projects/:id/queue kind task) does not become a ready task. Design §3.4 replaces the queue form (types, priorities) with one 'Note for the next session' box on the Overview; do that, keeping what the queue's existing items mean.

wave 2 (repeats wave 1's 'drain queued starts on session end'): a queued start waits up to one scheduler tick (30 s, triggers.ts tickMs) after the session ends. Answers say 'it runs after the current session' and then nothing happens for up to 30 s. Drain the agent's pending starts when its session ends; test with a real-daemon case (no real-time waits over a few seconds; leave nothing queued for the next test).
system-text: Session log lines (views.ts describeEvent, event-lines.ts): 'Session ended: killed (stop all), spent CHF 0.00: 0 done, 0 failed, 0 need you, 0 sent back, 0 in review, 0 not started' (zero counts, 'killed'); 'Finished task: killed (CHF 0.00). run stopped by its caller'; task.finished lines embed the report's markdown ('**Summary** … **Criteria**'); task.step / session.replanned / session.stopped / task.retrying fall back to 'Task step: …' / 'Session replanned: …' (each now carries a 'text' field). Word them per §5: whose stop (stopReason you/stop_all/quit/interrupted), no zero counts, no markdown.

Notification titles: "Alice's session killed: 0 done", "Alice's session stopped: 0 done, 1 sent back, 1 not started". counts.ts countsOf counts a sent-back-and-requeued task twice (retried and skipped; session-counts.test.ts was changed to accept '1 sent back, 1 not started' for one task: fix the double count and restore a correct expectation) and counts a task the person paused/stopped under 'needs you' (use isPausedByPerson).

result.ts lowerFirst lowercases a proper noun: '"Create index.html" failed: claude did not answer (model call failed).' Keep 'Claude' and other proper nouns capitalised; word the failure plainly ('Claude did not answer').

When the person stops or cancels the only task a session was running and nothing else finishes, the session posts an Inbox Update that reads just '<Project>: CHF 0.00.' (runner.ts onlyTheirStop covers only session-level stops). No Update for a person's own stop with nothing done (§5.11).
A stopped or empty-handed session is still graded 100 by the session review: grade nothing for a session that did nothing, or say so plainly.

Raw texts reaching the task drawer and Inbox from the runner/critic: 'Retry ladder exhausted … attempt(s)', '2 question(s) from coder', 'Accepted: 1 changed file(s) match the brief.', 'run stopped by its caller'; the drawer's review findings listed the same finding four times. Use plainPlurals (daemon/task-words.ts), dedupe findings, word them per §5 (coordinate the retry card text with needs-me, wave 2, already merged when you start).

The Changes page shows the raw action key as what the person said: 'Said: "go_ahead"', "pause", "stop" (server.ts ~1047 passes body.note ?? body.action as wordsUsed): use the button's words (ACTION_WORDS).

The Plan tab still shows 'light review (tier 1)' (plain-words.ts reviewLevel used by PlanTab.tsx); lib/task-actions.ts reviewLevelName gives the words without 'tier'. Same for any other 'tier N' a person sees.
restoreStatus can refuse an undo with 'task <uuid> has N open finding(s)', which reaches the Tasks tab's 'Not undone: …' line: word it without the id and '(s)'.
Minor: the drawer's Docker detail line is 116 characters (rule ≤100); 'Who does it' shows 'Agent's choice' while the cap line says '(coder limit)'.

U-044 (engine, deferred twice): task.started is emitted before the executor swaps specialist, so the log says 'designer' while writer-marketing / migration-specialist does a CSS/JS task; the retry ladder's alternate is not chosen by task kind (registry/alternates.ts). Emit task.started (or a correction line) after the specialist is chosen and pick alternates by kind, with tests.

wave 2: Session Updates repeat what a card already says ('"X" needs your decision (Inbox).' beside the card, sometimes twice) and go stale (still 'needs your decision' after it was answered). Design §5.10 one place per fact, §1 true now. sessionUpdateLine / runner: drop the line when a card exists, or word it so it stays true.

wave 2: runner.ts ~1901-1915 `carded` counts every open card with a task_id, the Docker card included, so a task the person paused while it had a Docker card is summarised as needing a decision instead of 'Paused by you'. Use task-words.ts holdsTask(card).

wave 2: A chat Yes/No card in the Inbox has a proper title now (change_card.ask) but its buttons are the stored lowercase 'yes'/'no' with no explain lines (request-words.ts genericCard). Show labels and explain lines from the card's words while sending the same answer values.

wave 2: Budget and autonomy read-backs in chat render the whole change card ('Change: … Scope: … How long … Risk: medium. Spend impact: +CHF 15. Undo: Undo it from Changes.'). Design §5: one line, no 'Risk' wording.
wave 2: The chat's start card shows 'Estimated CHF 5.00' under '(up to CHF 5)?': one figure, once, two decimals.
wave 2: 'try the style task again' is refused with 'Not done: several tasks match "style".' without naming the matches or what to type (§5 rule 8).

wave 2: Model-facing chat context still carries ids and raw words: open_requests id prefix ('01a198be:'), '[id …]' in the system prompt, task_get 'Waits for: "X" (needs_human)', 'Review: revise …', 'Ended because: completed', 'by the writer-marketing'. Use the person's words (project-facts.ts, conversation tools).
wave 2: NO_MODEL_CHAT_REPLY (packages/runtime/src/setup/no-model.ts) lists 'start a session' among what works without a model, but session.start now refuses when Claude is not connected.
